summary: Most core sections are implemented as a single-page, scroll-to-section site with active nav highlighting, premium theme styling, backend-sourced catalog querying, and React Query mutations for order/inquiry submission. However, some requirements are either not clearly satisfied (logo placeholder labeling, catalog category card/tile layout) or cannot be verified from the truncated backend diff (stable persistence, required backend APIs).

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide a clearly marked logo placeholder region (e.g., framed box with 'Logo' label), visually distinct and responsive.
missing_requirements.reason: A logo region exists, but it is rendered as a scissors icon without an explicit 'Logo' placeholder label/marked area as requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Catalog section must showcase categories (Suits, Shirts, Pants, Traditional wear) as presentable cards/tiles with title and brief placeholder description, and allow choosing a style for the order form.
missing_requirements.reason: The UI shows category filter buttons and a styles grid; the diff does not show categories presented as card/tile layout with descriptions.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication provider/hooks integrated into the app despite authentication not being required for this scope.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest states no user accounts/auth flows are required; Internet Identity is allowed but not required. The diff adds an II provider and identity-aware actor creation.

hallucinated_features.description: Caffeine.ai promotional footer link ('Built with ... using caffeine.ai').
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in the BuildRequest requirements or acceptance criteria.
